first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and record-bound type/use evidence for Historic England NHLE ListEntry 1306502 in Exeter. The official NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer exposing ListEntry, Name and Grade and was last edited on 2026-08-06, but the exact single-record GeoJSON query for 1306502 could not be retrieved through the web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload was read; therefore no geometry or record attributes were fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
